name: Alpaca
description: Alpaca bars and dividends, IEX and SIP, split-adjusted and total return, served as a source plugin. Keys arrive with each call and are never held.

providers.note: Provisional. Arvo's installer refuses providers until its supervisor (ADR-0023) can own the process; this entry is what that supervisor will read. Until then, build and run the binary by hand and list its address in plugins.toml.
